# Reylong Machinery Co., Ltd.
# REY LONG MACHINERY INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD.
# 瑞隆機械工業股份有限公司

## About
Reylong Machinery is a Taiwan-based manufacturer specializing in plastic and packaging machinery, including woven bag making machines, flexographic printing machines, and related industrial equipment. Founded and headquartered in Dou-Liu City, Yunlin County, Taiwan.

## Products
Reylong manufactures industrial machinery for the plastic woven bag and packaging industry:
- Flexographic printing machines (roll-to-roll, multi-color)
- Woven bag making machines
- Lamination machines
- Cutting and sewing machines
- Circular looms and related equipment

All machines are designed for high-speed, continuous production in B2B industrial environments.
